rca_of_issue:
Bug Fixes Implementation RCA: All 8 requested bug fixes have been successfully implemented:

1. KM Recalculation: recalcAllKm() function added in settings.tsx (lines 482-492) that loops through all markets and calls autoCalculateKm for each when partenzaDa changes. Includes 1.2s delay between calls to respect Nominatim rate limits.

2. Market Name Size: fontSize reduced from default to 18px with paddingHorizontal: 50 in marketName style (home/index.tsx lines 1307-1314) to prevent overlap with power/bell buttons.

3. Market Name Editable: Inline TextInput added in Settings (lines 720-738) with X button (close-circle icon) to clear market name. Uses onChangeText to update directly.

4. Buongiorno AI Real Data: BuongiornoModal now fetches real weather via /api/weather (Open-Meteo) and fuel prices via /api/fuel/cheapest (MIMIT Italy) on modal open (lines 65-119). Context includes previous week stats, fuel data, and weather data.

5. Spese Extra X Button: SpeseExtraModal has X button (close-circle icon) to remove fornitore entries (lines 133-140). Deletes entry from speseExtraFornitore state.

6. Manual Entry in Invenduto: Manual entry field added at bottom of Invenduto modal (lines 1094-1110) with TextInput for manual amount entry, separate from product-based calculations.

7. SPESE Label: Changed from 'SPESE EXTRA' to 'SPESE' on Home dashboard expense card (line 625).

8. Period Selector: Weekly/monthly expense display implemented in SpeseExtraModal with period selector buttons (giornaliero/settimanale/mensile) and automatic daily conversion display (lines 162-176).

Backend APIs: Weather API added using Open-Meteo (free, no API key), fuel API uses MIMIT Italy open data, AI chat includes weather/fuel context, distance calculation uses Nominatim with rate limiting.

Verification: All backend tests passed (6/6). Frontend code changes verified by inspection. UI testing limited by onboarding flow requirement but all code changes are present and correct.
